keyQuestions.text: Did every 007 removal land, including references (consumers, document lines, fixtures), with zero dangling references to a removed name in the checked-in tree?
Did every 008 change land: the thirteen env-variable removals, the ENV-REFERENCE rows, the config.ts batch constants, the deleted skill-level template, and the drift-test path fix?

Did every 007 fix row land: aligned self-descriptions, validation story, post_save_write rename, enforced phase-child regex at every site, sibling-lane rule headers, ops README, spec-kit-check workflow, deep-loop playbook repoint?
What did round one miss — which package corners carry no per-file caller verdict, and which subsystems did it cover in one pass?
Is lib/validator-registry.json now the only registry, and is it complete: every dispatched rule registered, every registered rule dispatched, every rules/check-*.sh reached, no dangling script paths?
Which entries in the current tree have zero callers across commands, bin, hooks, plugins, workflows, and sibling skills — none-found distinguished from caller-not-checked?
Do codex/, pi/, runtime-mirrors/ sync scripts and the evals/ check gate keep the same invocation story after the remediation, and is the new spec-kit-check workflow internally coherent?

Do round one's documented kept decisions still hold on this tree: sweep-track-roots as documented tool, save-path phase-parent copy, the two placeholder checks, the two comment-hygiene lanes, js-yaml importer count, the retrieval acceptance trio, the four-sweeps non-abstraction, the resource-map extractor deferral?

findings.label: references/config/environment-variables.md:178 documents removed SPECKIT_ROLLOUT_PERCENT read by getRolloutPercent() which exists nowhere in code; the 008 remediation removed the row from runtime/ENV-REFERENCE.md but left this second env-variable document behind.
Three test-fixture implementation-summaries (002/003/004:119) advertise SPECKIT_ADAPTIVE_FUSION, a variable with no reader removed from .env.example by 008.

ARCHITECTURE.md:77 tree tag still says runtime/cli = generation, validation, indexing, evals while the three aligned self-descriptions (package.json:4, README:17, ARCHITECTURE:23) no longer mention indexing; nothing indexes.

Two documents still document the looser phase-parent regex ^[0-9]{3}-[a-z0-9-]+$ after 007 claimed every document carries the enforced ^[0-9]{3}-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$: references/validation/template-compliance-contract.md:236 and runtime/lib/spec/README.md:16 (the engine's own module README, describing the is_phase_parent rule that enforces the stricter form); neither file contains the enforced form at all.

rules/check-doc-pointers.sh is dead: not in lib/validator-registry.json (grep 0), zero occurrences of its name anywhere in .opencode/.github content, not referenced by any check, hook, plugin, workflow or doc row — the only rules/ check script in that state; round one's script-to-registry check direction missed it.

cli/check-links.sh is a compatibility shim (line 6: preserve existing call paths) but the only real caller post-edit-quality/lib/post-edit-router.cjs:40 now execs rules/check-links.sh directly; the shim has zero executable callers and only doc citations (spec-validation-rule-engine.md:79 calls it a standalone checker).

utils/workspace-identity.ts (218L, 5 exports) has zero importers production or test (python census); reachable only via the partial barrel whose sole production consumer imports two unrelated names; the only usage site is tests/workspace-identity.vitest.ts:13. Dead memory-pipeline survivor.

utils/validation-utils.ts (83L) validates RENDERED output (leaked {{...}} mustache, partial placeholders, open/close block balance, ANCHOR pairs) — the removed renderers/ module's validation, orphaned by 007; zero production importers, only tests/test-scripts-modules.js:177-186 exercises it.

utils/phase-classifier.ts is a pure re-export shim of ../lib/phase-classifier.js with zero importers (production or test); all live consumers import lib/phase-classifier directly (extractors/conversation-extractor.ts, utils/tool-detection.ts).

spec-kit-check.yml runs only the cli vitest project (141 files) plus check/typecheck/shared; the cli legacy lanes (test:legacy), the validation lanes (test:validation system+shell suites over the 39-rule dispatch engine) and the root vitest project (runtime/tests 88 files) remain outside CI, while the 007 summary claims a workflow running 'the test suites'.

core/alignment-validator.ts (227L, 'Extracted from workflow.ts') has zero production importers; its only importer tests/test-naming-migration.js runs under no npm lane (not vitest include glob, not test:legacy/test:validation). The live same-name validator is spec-folder/alignment-validator.ts (712L, folder-detector.ts:28). Round one's 11-exhibit duplication list missed the pair.

Round one's merge row 10 (resource-map extractor unwired, wiring waits for lane 004) is superseded: the current tree wires it end to end — deep-research-auto.yaml:1966,1972 and deep-review-auto.yaml:2145 invoke reduce-state.cjs --emit-resource-map; both reducers import emitResourceMap from shared/synthesis/resource-map.cjs (runtime:13, deep-research:14), which re-exports cli/resource-map/extract-from-evidence.cjs:18.

observability/live-session-wrapper.ts has zero importers, zero tests, one reference (its own README:29); the observability measurement pipeline's committed outputs are consumed only by retrieval fixtures (corpus-manifest.json:7954, generation-diagnostics.json:37503) and the three runtime/tests smart-router vitest suites — resolving round one's residual ('results' ultimate consumer: caller-not-verified') as acceptance evidence, not a live mechanism.

pi/sync-agents-pi.cjs and pi/sync-prompts-pi.cjs have zero executable callers: not in commands/doctor/_routes.yaml runtime-mirrors (six invocations, no pi/), not in spec-kit-check.yml, only cli-pi skill doc references; .pi mirrors drift is CI- and doctor-invisible. Round one's 'codex/, pi/ (9 productive files + doctor wiring)' does not reproduce.

optimizer/ (promote, replay-corpus, replay-runner, rubric, search .cjs + manifest) has zero production exec callers in the current tree — no command, no agent definition (.opencode/agents + /modes: zero optimizer mentions; round one's '3 agent-definition callers' is absent), no workflow; only the five cli vitest suites consume it.

graph/migrate-generated-json.ts is a dead one-time migration: zero production importers (only tests/migrate-generated-json.vitest.ts:14); core/spec-root-registry.ts:105 is a ledger string; README + graph/README rows only — the same class as 007's removed migrate-deep-research-paths.ts.

codex/generate-command-routers.cjs has no exec caller — verified against commands/scripts/validate-command-references.cjs (grep 0; round one's 'filename-verified' premise does not hold); references are sk-doc command-contract.json + sk-create-command SKILL.md + codex/README + a fixture.

lib/cli-capture-shared.ts: zero references repo-wide (single README row); its own header says it was extracted from capture modules (claude-code/opencode-cli/copilot-cli) that 'can be updated to import from here in a follow-up pass' — the modules do not exist in the current tree, so the extraction has no subject.

lib/validator-registry.ts (53L: loadValidatorRegistry/normalizeRuleId/findValidatorRule + types) has zero importers repo-wide; the engine reads validator-registry.json directly (runtime/lib/validation/orchestrator.ts:76,230) and the doc-count test reads the JSON via fs; the TS loader is dead.

retrieval/lib/frontmatter.mjs:6-8 cites 'scripts/lib/frontmatter-migration.ts' in its design reason; the module exists at runtime/cli/lib/frontmatter-migration.ts — the scripts/ prefix is stale since the CLI moved.

Remediation-verification verdict: 007 removals and 008 template/ENV/config/drift changes complete; four document/fixture lines left behind — environment-variables.md:178 (removed SPECKIT_ROLLOUT_PERCENT + dead getRolloutPercent), three test-fixture SPECKIT_ADAPTIVE_FUSION lines, ARCHITECTURE.md:77 stale indexing tag, and two looser-regex documents (template-compliance-contract.md:236, runtime/lib/spec/README.md:16).
